title: A year after losing $1.46 billion, Bybit says AI helped it save $700 million
summary: The exchange that lost $1.46 billion to North Korean hackers is the first large centralized firm to put numbers on a claim bitcoin developers have been making all month.

title: Maya Protocol exploit drains bitcoin and other assets as pool value drops by $11 million
